catalogue_requests.summary: Move the stage relative to its current position by a distance in the stage unit (mm or degree) and report the position the controller returns.

notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware was attached or run, and the native.py hardware path was not run. The fake is an in-memory stand-in, not a recording: it does not model motion kinematics, the serial framing or the controller status bits beyond the values the driver reads. Position, maximum velocity, acceleration, speed-scale and relative-distance bounds depend on the stage mounted on the controller and are operator_required; site-limits.example.json is an example overlay, not a statement about any stage. The upstream MotorCtrl has no stop method, so native.py wraps its port with a stop() that sends the documented APT MGMSG_MOT_MOVE_STOP message; the @estop and the cap.motion.stop.v1 safe-state action both use it, and the e-stop also calls set_min_vel(0), the documented default minimum velocity. No estop_physical_ref is set; the cap.motion.stop.v1 safe-state action is the declarative safe-state stop. This R1 package does not claim the loader's R2/R3 unreviewed-hardware refusal. gate.digest is the digest line the last gate run printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
